facts.fact: The Ministry of Interior and UM6P deck says the National Population Registry offers an authentication service, with 70M+ authentications reported.

The deck says the registry's authentication service compares data declared at registration for social programmes with the RNP's, and that six social programmes (RSU, AMOT, ASD, AMO, CHAMIL and others) are integrated.

The digital transition ministry and the DGSN signed a framework agreement on 2 May 2025 to make the identity verification services of the national trusted-third-party platform available for e-government, tied to the new electronic national ID card.

DGSN says 29 partner service providers use the Mon e-ID platform to authenticate users, including for the criminal record, nationality certificate and housing aid requests.

facts.fact: DGSN's ID4Africa 2026 playbook says Morocco's digital identity platform, built on the national CNIE card and authenticating by PIN or fingerprint, has 5 million unique users and 15 million transactions since 2022.
DGSN says the digital identity platform serves 73 services and 54 partners, including CNSS, AMO, the judicial record and Massar, and banks, insurers and telecoms use it for instant KYC.
DGSN says the CNIE digitised on a smartphone is now used on a par with the physical card, derived at public kiosks or on a non-NFC phone, with online authentication on compatible services.

A joint DGSN and Bank Al-Maghrib communique of 7 October 2024 says the DGSN has developed a trusted-third-party identity verification platform, linked to the digital identity system, that gives instant automatic verification in person or remotely.
